name: Soybean Crush Spread — Processing Margin Monitor
description: CBOT board crush spread: ZM × (44/2000) + ZL × (11/100) − ZS/100, expressed in $/bushel. Shows the gross processing margin for soybean crushers. Includes 252-day rolling z-score to identify historically rich/cheap levels, event markers for extreme readings (|z| > 2), and a summary statistics table.
source:
# Soybean Crush Spread — CBOT Board Crush
# Crush = ZM × (44/2000) + ZL × (11/100) − ZS/100
# ZM: $/short ton, ZL: cents/lb, ZS: cents/bushel
# Result: $/bushel gross processing margin

# --- Data: Load all three legs via reference_futures + continuation ---
# NoAdjustment per D16 — cross-commodity ratio requires unadjusted prices
zs_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZS')()
zs = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zs_raw.o, zs_raw.h, zs_raw.l, zs_raw.c, zs_raw.v, zs_raw.oi, zs_raw.s)

zm_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZM')()
zm = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zm_raw.o, zm_raw.h, zm_raw.l, zm_raw.c, zm_raw.v, zm_raw.oi, zm_raw.s)

zl_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZL')()
zl = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zl_raw.o, zl_raw.h, zl_raw.l, zl_raw.c, zl_raw.v, zl_raw.oi, zl_raw.s)

# --- Crush Spread Calculation ---
# 1 bushel soybeans (60 lbs) yields ~44 lbs meal + ~11 lbs oil
# ZM in $/short ton → per bushel: ZM × 44/2000 = ZM × 0.022
# ZL in cents/lb → per bushel: ZL × 11/100 = ZL × 0.11
# ZS in cents/bushel → per bushel: ZS / 100
meal_value = zm.c * 0.022
oil_value = zl.c * 0.11
bean_cost = zs.c / 100.0
crush = meal_value + oil_value - bean_cost

# --- Analytics ---
# 1-year moving average for trend context
crush_ma = ma(period=252, type=MAType.sma)(crush)

# 252-day rolling z-score: how far from normal?
crush_z = zscore(window=252)(crush)

# Percentile rank: where in the historical distribution?
crush_pctrank = percentrank(period=252)(crush)

# --- Extreme Detection ---
# Z > 2 = historically rich (expensive to crush)
# Z < -2 = historically cheap (cheap to crush)
is_extreme_rich = is_valid(crush_z) and crush_z > 2.0
is_extreme_cheap = is_valid(crush_z) and crush_z < -2.0
is_extreme = is_extreme_rich or is_extreme_cheap
regime_label = conditional_select(is_extreme_rich, "Rich", is_extreme_cheap, "Cheap", "Normal")

# --- Output 1: Crush Spread Over Time ---
ts = index().value
xy_lines(
    title='Soybean Crush Spread — Where Is the Processing Margin?',
    category='Crush Spread',
    y_axis_label='$/bushel',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Crush Spread', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='252d MA', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Breakeven')
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(crush, crush_ma))

# --- Output 2: Z-Score — Rich or Cheap? ---
xy_lines(
    title='Is the Crush Spread Rich or Cheap? (252d Z-Score)',
    category='Crush Spread',
    y_axis_label='Z-Score',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Crush Z-Score', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Mean'),
        ReferenceLine(value=2.0, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Rich (+2σ)'),
        ReferenceLine(value=-2.0, color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Cheap (−2σ)')
    ]),
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=-2.0, to=2.0, color=Color.Blue, opacity=0.05, label='Normal Range')
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(crush_z,))

# --- Output 3: Event Markers for Extreme Readings ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Crush Spread Extreme',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Crush ($/bu)', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Z-Score', dp=1, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='Regime', type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='Percentile', dp=0, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(crush, crush_z, regime_label, crush_pctrank, is_extreme)

# --- Output 4: Summary Statistics ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='Crush Spread',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Crush Spread Key Statistics',
        row_size=3, col_size=3,
        row_headers=['Level', 'Positioning', 'Range'],
        col_headers=['Current', 'Context', 'Extreme'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                       type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, info='Latest crush spread $/bu'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                       type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, info='Historical average'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median,
                       type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, info='Historical median'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                       type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1, info='Current z-score'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                       type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0, info='Current percentile rank (0-100)'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count,
                       type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, info='Days at extreme (|z|>2)'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min,
                       type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, info='All-time low'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max,
                       type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, info='All-time high'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std,
                       type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, info='Historical std dev')
        ]
    ),
    order=3
)(crush, crush, crush, crush_z, crush_pctrank, where(is_extreme, crush_z), crush, crush, crush)
